tools.name: create_soundscape
tools.description: Turn a description into synthesized ambience or effects. Use thunder, surf, fire, drips, footsteps, or engine for those sources. Specify timing, rate, stereo movement, distance and fades when requested. Return the WAV and editable recipe links. For follow-up changes, use revise_soundscape with the r

tools.name: revise_soundscape
tools.description: Edit specific layers by number, remove layers, add layers, adjust length, or change the seed. Use the reference from a previous Noise Alter result. Unedited layers keep their timing and seed unless you explicitly change the seed.
